en-US.pack.sunny_home_garden_2.title: Sunny Home Garden 2
en-US.pack.sunny_home_garden_2.summary: A gentle second pack for little hands: two four-step lessons with Puff and Moss — point to familiar things, and sort the same kind together. Stored on this device only.
en-US.character.puff.name: Puff
en-US.character.moss.name: Moss
en-US.character.puff.line_1: Hello, friend! Shall we wave hello together?
en-US.character.puff.line_2: Look what is in my flower basket — let us see together!
en-US.character.puff.design_bible.silhouette: Soft cloud-shaped fluffy body made of overlapping rounded cloud puffs; fluffy cloud arms that often wave hello. Round and soft, reads as a cloud at thumbnail size.
en-US.character.puff.design_bible.palette: Body soft white (#FBFCFE); shading light sky-blue (#A9D3F0); eyes brown (#6B4A2F); cheeks pink (#F2A7B4).
en-US.character.puff.design_bible.outfit: Striped sky-blue scarf — this is the whole outfit; no other clothing.
en-US.character.puff.design_bible.prop: Small basket of flowers; the only prop.
en-US.character.puff.design_bible.face: Round friendly face, big brown eyes, pink cheeks, gentle happy expression.
en-US.character.puff.design_bible.movement: Fluffy cloud arms often wave hello; bright and bouncy.
en-US.character.puff.design_bible.hard_negativ: Never a human child, never a person; no hair, no necklace, no human ears, no legs or feet.
en-US.character.moss.line_1: What does our little sprout need today? Let us look together.
en-US.character.moss.line_2: We can water gently and take our time.
en-US.character.moss.design_bible.silhouette: Round mushroom-cap sprite — a terracotta-brown mushroom cap with cream spots on top of a cream round face and body; reads as a round mushroom at thumbnail size.
en-US.character.moss.design_bible.palette: Cap terracotta-brown (#B5651D); spots, face and body cream (#F7EBD6); eyes brown (#6B4A2F); cheeks pink (#F2A7B4); vest sage-green (#9CAF88); shorts brown (#6B4A2F).
en-US.character.moss.design_bible.outfit: Little sage-green vest over brown shorts — fully dressed; no other clothing.
en-US.character.moss.design_bible.prop: Small potted sprout and a small silver watering can.
en-US.character.moss.design_bible.face: Cream round face, big brown eyes, pink cheeks, warm friendly smile.
en-US.character.moss.design_bible.movement: Sways gently while waiting; warm, friendly, and patient.
en-US.character.moss.design_bible.hard_negativ: Never a human child, never a person; no hair, no necklace, no human ears (the cap is the head); no bare torso (always vested).

en-US.lesson.words_that_sound_the_same.title: Words That Sound the Same!
Cat, hat! They sound the same. Tap the hat!
You found the hat — hat sounds like cat!
Dog, frog! They sound the same. Tap the frog!
You found the frog — frog sounds like dog!
Find the picture that sounds like moon!
You found the spoon — spoon sounds like moon!
Find the picture that sounds like star!
You found the car — car sounds like star!
Find the picture that sounds like bee!
You found the tree — tree sounds like bee!
en-US.lesson.words_that_sound_the_same.closing: Words that sound the same — you heard them all!

en-US.lesson.finish_the_rhyme.step_2.celebrati: You picked the log — log finishes dog and frog!
en-US.lesson.finish_the_rhyme.step_3.celebrati: You picked the balloon — balloon finishes moon and spoon!
en-US.lesson.finish_the_rhyme.step_4.celebrati: You picked the jar — jar finishes star and car!
en-US.lesson.finish_the_rhyme.step_5.celebrati: You picked the key — key finishes bee and tree!
en-US.lesson.clap_the_beats.title: Clap the Beats!
en-US.lesson.clap_the_beats.step_1.prompt: Listen and clap with me: cup! Tap the card with the same beats!
en-US.lesson.clap_the_beats.step_1.celebration: You tapped 1 beat — cup has 1 beat!
en-US.lesson.clap_the_beats.step_2.prompt: Listen and clap with me: book! Tap the card with the same beats!
en-US.lesson.clap_the_beats.step_2.celebration: You tapped 1 beat — book has 1 beat!
en-US.lesson.clap_the_beats.step_3.prompt: Listen and clap with me: flow-er! Tap the card with the same beats!
en-US.lesson.clap_the_beats.step_3.celebration: You tapped 2 beats — flower has 2 beats!
en-US.lesson.clap_the_beats.step_4.prompt: Listen and clap with me: gar-den! Tap the card with the same beats!
en-US.lesson.clap_the_beats.step_4.celebration: You tapped 2 beats — garden has 2 beats!
en-US.lesson.clap_the_beats.step_5.prompt: Listen and clap with me: ba-na-na! Tap the card with the same beats!
en-US.lesson.clap_the_beats.step_5.celebration: You tapped 3 beats — banana has 3 beats!
en-US.lesson.clap_the_beats.find_prompt: Let’s find the card with 3 beats together!
en-US.lesson.first_sounds.title: First Sounds!
en-US.lesson.first_sounds.step_1.prompt: Listen: buh… ear. Tap the bear!
en-US.lesson.first_sounds.step_1.celebration: You found the bear — bear starts with buh!
en-US.lesson.first_sounds.step_2.prompt: Listen: kuh… at. Tap the cat!
en-US.lesson.first_sounds.step_2.celebration: You found the cat — cat starts with kuh!
en-US.lesson.first_sounds.step_3.prompt: Bear starts with the buh sound. Tap another picture that starts with buh!
en-US.lesson.first_sounds.step_3.celebration: You found the ball — ball starts with buh!
en-US.lesson.first_sounds.step_4.prompt: Cat starts with the kuh sound. Tap another picture that starts with kuh!
en-US.lesson.first_sounds.step_4.celebration: You found the cup — cup starts with kuh!
en-US.lesson.first_sounds.step_5.prompt: Which picture starts with the fuh sound?
en-US.lesson.first_sounds.step_5.celebration: You found the frog — frog starts with fuh!
en-US.lesson.first_sounds.closing_win: First sounds — you heard them all!

en-US.lesson.name_it_together.title: Name It Together!
en-US.lesson.name_it_together.step_1.prompt: Say 'cup' together with your grown-up — then tap the cup!
en-US.lesson.name_it_together.step_2.prompt: Say 'spoon' together with your grown-up — then tap the spoon!
en-US.lesson.name_it_together.step_3.prompt: Say 'book' together with your grown-up — then tap the book!

en-US.lesson.name_it_together.step_4.celebrati: You chose the cup and named it together!
en-US.lesson.name_it_together.step_5.prompt: Choose something to name together! Tap something you can bounce, then say it together!
